question: The surface area of a sphere is 25pi{cm²}. The volume of the sphere is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given **Surface Area** = 4πr² = 25π ⇒ r² = 25/4 ⇒ **r = 5/2 cm**.

**Volume** = (4/3)πr³ = (4/3)π(5/2)³ = (4/3)π(125/8).

On simplifying, **Volume** = (125π)/6 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 125π/6 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Surface Area of **Sphere** = 25π cm²

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Surface Area (S) = 4πr²

⇒ Volume (V) = (4/3)πr³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d1faeab838b88972428655b41bdbca7d05ffad777668fec42feb3b183f15d98.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4πr² = 25π

⇒ r² = 25/4

⇒ r = √(25/4) = 5/2 cm

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × π × (5/2)³

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × π × (125/8)

⇒ Volume = (1 × π × 125) / (3 × 2)

⇒ Volume = 125π/6 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 125π/6 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Sphere

A sphere is a perfectly round geometrical object in three-dimensional space. Surface Area = 4πr² and Volume = (4/3)πr³.

Hemisphere Formulas

For a solid hemisphere, Curved Surface Area = 2πr², Total Surface Area = 3πr², and Volume = (2/3)πr³.

Ratio relations

If the ratio of radii of two spheres is a:b, then the ratio of their surface areas is a²:b² and the ratio of their volumes is a³:b³.</p
